page.overview:
Who is Tanuki?

In the Street Fighter series, tanuki are common near Ibuki's ninja village, and she has a pet tanuki named Don-chan. The village has a tanuki population of 256.

Ibuki tends to have many Tanuki themed aesthetics. Some of these include, Raccoon tails on outfits, Raccoon faces on her weapons (EG Smoke Bomb), and even a scrapped Raccoon outfit. In Super Gem Fighter Mini Mix, Ibuki throws tanuki statues when using Kasumi Suzaku.
